networks.name: fairsquare
networks.description: Negotiate price, delivery and warranty with a merchant agent; a neutral referee scores every deal for fairness and signs a certificate.
sample_queries: What can I buy here and what is negotiable?
Open a negotiation for the refurbished laptop; my value is $470, warranty is worth $7/month to me.
Is the merchant's current offer certifiable?

llm_router.note: This version runs no language model. The concierge, merchant and referee are executed by deterministic JavaScript in index.html (see ./agents.json). The network definition is published for portability; LLM execution through a Profile 0.3 runtime is planned.

peer_policy.note: FairSquare contacts no third-party origin. Visiting agents call it; it does not call out.

agent_mcp.reason: Static GitHub Pages bundle; no public MCP facade.

fairsquare_profile_extension.description: Agent visitors as first-class principals; window API, postMessage, WebMCP and URL-query transports; /inspect, /negotiate, /certify; ES256 proof-of-fairness certificates.
